mechanism_evidence.contract: get_node_list unwraps a single-Schedule list to a slice copy of its children: the returned list is not (is not) the live children list, its elements are the children themselves (is); reordering the returned list leaves the tree untouched; captured at the get_node_list() call timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Pass [Schedule] to RegionTrans.get_node_list, then mutate the returned list.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: A list containing just a Schedule falls into the generic list branch and returns [sched] itself instead of the Schedule children.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Return nodes[0].children[:] for a single-Schedule list (same as Schedule input).

discriminating_observation.description:
from psyclone.psyir.nodes import Node, Schedule, IntrinsicCall, Reference
from psyclone.psyir.symbols import DataSymbol, REAL_TYPE
from psyclone.psyir.transformations import RegionTrans
class MyRT(RegionTrans):
    excluded_node_types = ()
    @property
    def name(self):
        return 'my_rt'
    def apply(self, node, options=None):
        pass
rt = MyRT()
sched = Schedule()
sym = DataSymbol('x', REAL_TYPE)
sched.children = [IntrinsicCall.create(IntrinsicCall.Intrinsic.SIN, [Reference(sym)])]
lst = rt.get_node_list([sched])
print('list_identity', lst is not sched.children, len(lst))
assert lst is not sched.children, 'node list shares the live children list'
assert len(lst) == 1, lst
assert lst[0] is sched.children[0], 'single-schedule list must unwrap to children'
lst.append(Node.__new__(Node))
assert len(sched.children) == 1, sched.children
lst2 = rt.get_node_list(sched.children)
assert lst2 is not sched.children and lst2 == list(sched.children)
print('f2_node_list_isolation', True)

triple.is_identity: lst is not sched.children (new list); lst[0] is sched.children[0] (shallow elements)
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: appending to the returned list leaves sched.children unchanged

mechanism_evidence.contract: Each scheduled instruction owns a per-node op copy: the scheduled op is not (is not) the original shared op; writing a duration on one node leaves the original and sibling nodes untouched; captured at the scheduling-pass write timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Schedule a circuit reusing one op instance across nodes (cz chain), then compare durations.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: Scheduled nodes share one op instance; the second duration write overwrites the first.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: new_op = node.op.copy() per node before storing duration (asap.py + alap.py).

from qiskit.circuit import QuantumRegister
from qiskit.circuit.library import CXGate
from qiskit.dagcircuit import DAGCircuit
from qiskit.transpiler.passes.scheduling.asap import ASAPSchedule
from qiskit.transpiler.instruction_durations import InstructionDurations
from qiskit.test.mock.backends import FakeParis
backend = FakeParis()
durs = InstructionDurations.from_backend(backend)
qr = QuantumRegister(3, 'q')
shared = CXGate()
dag = DAGCircuit()
dag.add_qreg(qr)
dag.apply_operation_back(shared, [qr[0], qr[1]], [])
dag.apply_operation_back(shared, [qr[1], qr[2]], [])
sched = ASAPSchedule(durs)
sched.property_set['time_unit'] = 'dt'
out = sched.run(dag)
cxs = [(node, node.op) for node in out.op_nodes() if node.name == 'cx']
assert len(cxs) == 2, len(cxs)
print('op_identity', cxs[0][1] is cxs[1][1], cxs[0][1].duration, cxs[1][1].duration)
assert cxs[0][1] is not cxs[1][1], 'scheduled gates share one op instance'
assert cxs[0][1].duration != cxs[1][1].duration, (cxs[0][1].duration, cxs[1][1].duration)
print('f2_sched_op_isolation', True)

triple.is_identity: cxs[0] is not cxs[1] (per-node op copies)
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: per-gate durations differ and match the backend table; original circuit ops untouched
